interpretation.fieldFacts: Independently organized flat wire facts, not vendor DTOs or a code-generation schema
interpretation.fieldProfiles: Lists of field-fact IDs deduplicating repeated request/response facts
interpretation.required: Required relative to the containing wire object when its listed condition holds; not a claim that an optional parent must be sent
interpretation.when: Wire discriminator conditions; Undiscriminated wire alternative means a separately checked combination, not an invented discriminator
interpretation.unspecified: Metadata does not assign a primitive type at that node; do not invent a typed payload contract
interpretation.omittedDefaults: Expressive string defaults are deliberately excluded; defaults equal to published wire enum values and scalar numeric/boolean defaults are retained
interpretation.admission: In chosen release scope, not implemented, entitled, permitted or live-conformant
interpretation.metadataOnly: Current family public metadata route without a mapped reference page; supported deployment/version must be verified
interpretation.testCaseIds: Planned traceability identifiers only; no tests are claimed executed
interpretation.preconditions: No global atomicity or retry guarantee is inferred from HTTP verbs
interpretation.sourceLimits: Public metadata/index snapshot only; prose-only constraints, edition matrices, transport behavior and private features remain explicit gates
interpretation.rootAndMapMarkers: $ denotes the message root; .* denotes a dynamic map key, not a literal wire property. unlistedFields is a published accept/reject fact; acceptsNoValue marks a prohibited wire member.

contractGates.requirement: Establish deployment version, supported metadata-only helpers and edition access without interpreting info.version as a floor
Verify operation-specific permission keys and bearer/proof/share/mTLS requirements; absent metadata security is not anonymous authorization
Resolve undescribed wire types, untagged alternatives, open maps and prose-only constraints before exposing a typed input; no raw JSON fallback
Verify lease/token timing, approvals/import replication, sync/rotation triggers, destructive effects, pagination and response limits through authorized tests
Verify endpoint trust, cancellation, redirect/token rules, response budgets, no mutation replay and diagnostic suppression through the chosen transport
Supported authorized programmable contract, provenance, edition/access/effect semantics and conformance before future admission
